title: L2-L3 and L3-L4 facet force in T12-S1 spines under imposed rotations and 400 N follower load (intact)
condition: intact (capsule incised for Tekscan sensor), 400 N follower load

quantity.name: facet force
quantity.definition: total facet joint force from Tekscan 6900 sensors, average of right and left facets, mean +- SE of 7 spines (Fig. 1 'Force' panel); SD derived

source.authors: Botolin S, Puttlitz C, Baldini T, Petrella A, Burger E, Abjornson C, Patel V
source.sample: 7 fresh-frozen human cadaveric lumbar spines potted at T12 and S1, screened for severe degeneration by radiographs/CT

protocol.summary: 6-DOF uncoupled spine tester, displacement control: 15 deg flexion/extension, 10 deg left/right lateral bending, 10 deg left/right axial rotation, 0.1 Hz, 4 cycles (2 preconditioning, 3rd analysed), with a constant 400 N compressive follower load. Tekscan 6900 sensors in left and right L2-L3 and L3-L4 facets through capsular incisions, calibrated to 500 N, 8 frames/s. Then ProDisc-L at L3-L4 (not extracted).
how_to_simulate: Model T12-S1 (or T12-L5 per abstract); fix the sacrum
Apply a 400 N compressive follower load
Impose 15 deg flexion or extension, or 10 deg lateral bending or axial rotation, on T12
Report facet contact force at L2-L3 and L3-L4, average of left and right facets (N)
protocol.notes: Abstract says potted at T12 and L5, methods say T12 and S1. Whether values are the peak of the cycle or averaged over left/right bending/rotation is not stated. Fig. 4 (FE cycle curves, n=6) not extracted. TDR data outside card scope.

extraction.check_notes: Review values (e.g. L3-L4 AR 40.8+/-5.5, ext 20.0+/-4.4; L2-L3 LB 13.9+/-2.3) match the 'PEAK FORCE' panel of Fig. 1 with SE, re-digitised here (L3-L4 ext 19.5, SE 4.6; L2-L3 LB 13.8, SE 2.4). Peak force is not the facet joint force (contact pressure x area ~ 'Force' panel). Corrected to the 'Force' panel; SE converted to SD; 400 N follower load added (review: 'preload not stated').
